targets.purpose: Observe the anonymous DNS, TCP, and certificate-validated TLS path to the official Anthropic API host used by Claude Code.
targets.authentication_requirement: Authentication is required for application requests; no authentication is used for DNS/TCP/TLS observation.
targets.privacy_notes: No HTTP request, request body, key, OAuth token, cookie, session data, certificate chain retention, or trust-store capture.
targets.interpretation_limits: DNS/TCP/validated TLS completion is provider-path evidence only. Application-layer and provider-health verdicts remain withheld.
